songs.title: Land Locked Heart
lyrics: Maybe I left here a long time ago
And neither of us knew it
Would they say I've lost the plot
Would you say I blew it
Thought I found a way back home
And now I'm looking through it
After all this time spent gone
I think I just outgrew it
Empty out my bedroom
Throw all that stuff away
All I'm taking with me now is a blank slate
'Cause these days are too short
To live a whole life through
In this land-locked,
In this land-locked heart with you
Maybe I left here a long time ago
And maybe we both knew it
Maybe this could've been heaven
But the weeds just grew right through it
So what is left of paradise
Out beyond it's edges
Empty lights, sunset skies
Over the empty hedges
Were we supposed to waste away
